import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/training_1.csv"

# Define output file path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source1 with Source0 on 'school_name' to get 'type' for each student
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source1, df_source0[['school_name', 'type']], on='school_name', how='inner')

# Group by 'type' and calculate average reading_score
df_result = df_joined.groupby('type', as_index=False)['reading_score'].mean()

# Ensure the column order and types match the target schema
df_result = df_result[['type', 'reading_score']]
df_result['type'] = df_result['type'].astype(str)
df_result['reading_score'] = df_result['reading_score'].astype(float)

# Save the result to the output CSV file
df_result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
